title: sh.fx extensions to the Agent Client Protocol, version 1
description: Draft. The types that sh-fx.md defines. The standard ACP types are in acp/v1/schema.json.

MethodName.description: The name of an sh.fx method or notification: `_sh.fx/` followed by `<area>/<action>` in snake_case.

CapabilityName.description: The name of an sh.fx capability: `sh.fx/` followed by a camelCase name.

MetaKey.description: An sh.fx key in a `_meta` object: `sh.fx/` followed by a camelCase name.

Capability.description: The value of an sh.fx capability entry. It stays empty unless the extension defines options. Peers ignore fields they don't know.

AgentCapabilitiesMeta.description: The sh.fx entries that fx lists in `agentCapabilities._meta` of its `initialize` response.

ClientCapabilitiesMeta.description: The sh.fx entries that a client lists in `clientCapabilities._meta` of its `initialize` request.

HostToolsCapability.description: The value of the sh.fx/hostTools capability that a client lists: the tools it runs for fx when fx sends `_sh.fx/tools/call`.

PromptDeliveryCapability.description: The value of the sh.fx/promptDelivery capability that fx lists: one entry for each delivery that fx supports.

PromptDelivery.description: The value of sh.fx/delivery in the `_meta` of a `session/prompt` request: what fx does with a prompt that arrives while a turn runs.

SteeringDelivery.description: The value of sh.fx/steeringDelivery in the `_meta` of the response to a steer: whether the running turn took the steer, or the steer ran in the next turn.

SteerInput.description: The value of sh.fx/steerInput in the `_meta` of a `user_message_chunk` update that shows a steer.

requestId.description: The request id of the `session/prompt` that sent the steer, or null for a host steer.

inputId.description: The input id of a host steer.

LogPosition.description: A position in a session's log, which names the last turn saved. Opaque: a client stores it and sends it back unchanged.

ReplayFrom.description: The value of sh.fx/replayFrom in the `_meta` of a `session/load` request: replay only the turns saved after this position.

Replay.description: The value of sh.fx/replay in the `_meta` of a `session/load` response: whether fx replayed the turns after the position, or the whole session because it didn't know the position.

ClientId.description: The id that fx gives a connection when it connects: sh.fx/clientId in the `_meta` of the `initialize` response, sh.fx/client in the `_meta` of a `user_message_chunk` from another client, and the `clientId` of a session client. Opaque.

Leader.description: The value of sh.fx/leader in the `_meta` of the `initialize` response that a leader socket answers: the pid of the fx acp process, and the ids of the sessions it leads.

SessionClient.description: One client that has the session open: its id, and the `clientInfo` it sent at `initialize`, which follows ACP's `Implementation`.

ClientsUpdateParams.description: The params of the `_sh.fx/session/clients_update` notification: every client that has the session open.

SubagentPrompt.description: The value of sh.fx/prompt in the `_meta` of a child's `capabilities` in a `subagent_update`: the child accepts `session/prompt` from the client, with the deliveries listed, for a client that lists sh.fx/subagentPrompts.

PromptRef.description: A prompt of a session, by the `messageId` of its user message, which stays the same on every load: the value of sh.fx/forkBefore in the `_meta` of `session/fork`, and the `before` of `_sh.fx/session/rewind`.

RewindParams.description: The params of `_sh.fx/session/rewind`: remove the turn of the prompt `before` names, and every turn after it.

HistoryReplacedParams.description: The params of the `_sh.fx/session/history_replaced` notification: a rewind changed the session's history, and the client loads it again.

TurnDiffParams.description: The params of `_sh.fx/session/turn_diff`: the turn, by its prompt, and whether to add each file's full review.

TurnDiffResult.description: The result of `_sh.fx/session/turn_diff`: the changes fx's own tools made in the turn, file by file.

running.description: The turn still runs, and the changes are those so far.

untracked.description: The turn ran a shell command, whose changes to files fx doesn't track.

FileChange.description: The combined changes of one file in a turn: as it was before the turn's first change to it, and after the last. The preview follows fx's terminal: up to 6 changed lines, each up to 4 KiB, 24 KiB in all.

truncated.description: fx cut the preview to its limits.

review.description: With `full` in the request: the changed lines with 5 lines of context, as fx's full transcript shows.

DiffLine.description: One line of a file change's preview or review.

SessionState.description: The value of sh.fx/state in the `_meta` of a `session/status` response and of a `session/list` row, and the `state` of a session state update: what the session is doing.

SessionStateUpdate.description: The `update` of `_sh.fx/session/state_update`: the states of ACP's `StateUpdate` that fx sends. ACP v2 sends the same object as a `state_update`.

stopReason.description: With `idle` after a turn: the turn's stopReason, one of ACP's StopReason values.

ListChangedParams.description: The params of the `_sh.fx/session/list_changed` notification: the folder whose list of sessions changed.

cwd.description: The absolute folder of the session that changed.

TurnPhase.description: The `phase` of a turn's progress: what the turn is doing.

TurnProgressParams.description: The params of the `_sh.fx/session/turn_progress` notification: the running turn's whole progress, not a change.

inputTokens.description: The turn's input tokens so far.

outputTokens.description: The turn's output tokens so far.

provider.description: The provider that served the turn's latest request, when the gateway names it.

ModelCallParams.description: The params of the `_sh.fx/session/model_call` notification: one model call that ended.

servedBy.description: The provider that served the call, when the gateway names it.

generationId.description: The provider's id for the call.

retryAfterSeconds.description: How long the provider asked fx to wait before a retry.

endedAt.description: When the call ended, as an ISO 8601 time.

TurnUsage.description: The value of `sh.fx/usage` in the `_meta` of a `session/prompt` response: what ACP's `usage` field lacks.

durationMs.description: From the prompt to the end of the turn.

thinkingMs.description: The time the model spent reasoning.

CommandResult.description: The value of `sh.fx/commandResult` in the `_meta` of the `tool_call_update` that ends a shell call. Values fx doesn't know are left out, and so are `terminationIndeterminate` and `outputIncomplete` when they are false.

command.description: The command as fx ran it.

timedOut.description: It ran past its time limit.

terminationIndeterminate.description: fx couldn't confirm how the command ended, so its effects may exist. Always true when present.

outputIncomplete.description: fx couldn't read all of its output. Always true when present.

stdoutBytes.description: Bytes it wrote to standard output.

stderrBytes.description: Bytes it wrote to standard error.

truncated.description: The output was larger than fx keeps in the call's text; the saved output holds all of it.

outputFile.description: The name under which fx saved the whole output, in the session's own store. A name, not a path.

stdoutFile.description: The name under which fx saved the whole standard output, in the session's own store.

stderrFile.description: The name under which fx saved the whole standard error, in the session's own store.
